authorization: The owner asked for mobile layout polish across chat, questions and map mode, then five council rounds ("Amazing, now do a few rounds of the council to improve this."), and after unanimous 10/10 council approval asked to ship ("Amazing, let's get this shipped!").

release.summary: The reader spread adapts to screen height as well as width through three new Tailwind variants (short, phone-short, phone-land). Sideways phones and low laptop windows collapse Ask to one button and tighten spacing so the verse shows; small sideways phones lay the picture beside the words page while keeping map controls, marker cards (narrowed to fit), verse marks (scaled gaps for dense chapters like Psalm 119), and unpainted controls visible; upright tablets keep at least a 352px words column with Look capped to the picture column and the picture chip/menus/play controls lifted clear of the dock; whole-picture mode keeps phone page turns in view, scrolls only overflowing short-window verses without blocking tap-through, and keeps prose captions clamped; Ask restores focus if its opener hides across a resize. Client only.
release.cause: Short phones, sideways phones, low laptop windows and upright tablets hid verses behind the Ask foot, clipped Look and map cards, hid dense chapter marks, or overlapped the picture chip with the page-turn dock.
release.leftOut: Nothing else was waiting: production was 2343bdb9 (#581); main since then held only the record PR #582 (docs) and #583.
